media_item.summary_notes: A 20/20 episode focusing on a wrongful conviction case involving DNA exoneration and misidentification. Due to the generic title, specific details are difficult to confirm, but information is primarily based on the case of Ray Krone.

featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Ray Krone was wrongfully convicted of murder in Arizona in 1992 and sentenced to death, later life imprisonment. His conviction was based on bite mark analysis and eyewitness testimony, but he was exonerated by DNA evidence in 2002 after serving approximately 10 years.
contributing_factors_raw: Bite mark analysis (later discredited/excluded by DNA)
